scope: All48 games, all technology selections and their recorded alternatives. Same tile is acquired once; whole-game blue1/blue2 receipts compare to acquisition-time predictions. Acquisition-selected comparison is descriptive and includes no counterfactual reward for unselected alternatives. New expected cycles are statistical, not guaranteed data/energy budgets. No partial cohort filtering.
